1.2.4.3-f10.accuracy_reason: Alciato's emblem 'In subitum terrorem' has Pan/Faunus asking who blows his horns, and the link to 'panic' is right. The double sense of 'cornua' is a fair reading of the joke.

1.2.4.3-f26.accuracy_reason: Aeneid 6.883 is Anchises speaking of Marcellus, Octavia's son and Augustus' nephew. Donatus' Life of Virgil says Octavia fainted, not Livia.
